name: v0.3.59 — Feature icons on the dashboard + tighter top bar
releaseNotes:
• Quick-access feature icons are back on the dashboard — a scrollable row (Worth It?, Guacanomics, GuacWizard, Steals, Rewards, Stash, Inbox, Miles) right under your snapshot.
• Tightened the spacing between the top-bar icons.
• Trimmed the empty gap above the bottom-bar icons.
